```{r}
#| message: false
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
#| label: iris-scatterplot
#| fig-cap: "Sepal length and width measurements for three iris species."
ggplot(iris, aes(x = Sepal.Width, y = Sepal.Length, color = Species)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      setosa = "red",
      versicolor = "green",
      virginica = "blue"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Measurements for Different Species of Iris",
    x = "Sepal width (cm)",
    y = "Sepal length (cm)",
    color = "Species"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
